test_title: PYST 46: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a major challenge for Indian cities due to rapid urbanisation?

options.text: Enhanced walkability in all city zones

solution: The correct answer is __**Pressure on infrastructure and services**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Rapid urbanisation** in India has led to a significant **pressure on infrastructure and services**, including transportation, housing, water supply, sanitation, waste management, and energy. • Indian cities often face challenges like **traffic congestion, inadequate housing, and unreliable water and electricity supply** due to the increasing population density. • The existing **urban infrastructure** is unable to meet the demands of the growing urban population, leading to poor living conditions in many areas. • Urbanisation has also caused an increase in environmental issues such as **air and water pollution, waste accumulation, and loss of green spaces**. • Government schemes like the **Smart Cities Mission** and **AMRUT (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation)** have been introduced to address these challenges but require significant efforts to achieve sustainable urban development.
